
# James Sims — Full-Stack Software Engineer

> Personal portfolio showcasing full-stack software engineering projects, technical skills, and professional experience.

Website: https://jameshsims.tech/

## About

James Sims is a full-stack software developer specializing in Ruby on Rails, React, JavaScript, and modern web application development.

## Projects

- [Full-Stack Messaging App](https://github.com/jameshsims91/messaging-app): A Rails and React messaging application featuring authentication, user profiles, conversations, and REST APIs.
- [React Shopping Cart](https://github.com/jameshsims91/shopping-cart): A responsive shopping application built with React and tested using Vitest.
- [Weather Dashboard](https://github.com/jameshsims91/weather-app): A JavaScript weather application featuring forecasts and external API integration.
- Photo Tagging Game: An interactive Rails and React game with server-side guess validation and leaderboard functionality.

## Technical Skills

- Ruby and Ruby on Rails
- JavaScript and React
- HTML, CSS, and responsive design
- PostgreSQL and REST APIs
- Automated testing with Vitest and Playwright
- Git and GitHub Actions
